_comment: Template for .mcp.json (project-scoped MCP servers, read by Claude Code).
NOT installed automatically: adding an MCP server means approving a remote
endpoint for everyone who opens this repo, so it stays an explicit action.
# then remove this _comment key and run: claude mcp list
The server KEYS must stay 'atlassian' and 'github': they match mcp_server and
github_mcp_server in dcm-config.yml, and Claude Code derives tool names from
Renaming a key silently breaks the allowed-tools lists in .claude/commands/.
github: export GITHUB_PAT with repo + read:org scopes before starting Claude.
atlassian: OAuth in the browser on first use, nothing to export.
Copilot in VS Code reads .vscode/mcp.json instead — a DIFFERENT schema
('servers' + 'inputs', ${input:name} prompts). Claude Code does not read it,
so both files are needed on a machine that uses both agents. Keep the
transports aligned: the team's working .vscode/mcp.json uses streamable http
on /v1/mcp for Atlassian, which is why this template does too — /v1/sse is
